task.subject: Fix `package_name` resolution when top-level module differs from distribution name

winning_diff:
--- a/src/click/decorators.py
+++ b/src/click/decorators.py
@@ -446,10 +446,25 @@ def version_option(
             try:
                 version = importlib.metadata.version(package_name)
             except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError:
-                raise RuntimeError(
-                    f"{package_name!r} is not installed. Try passing"
-                    " 'package_name' instead."
-                ) from None
+                # The name may be an import name that differs from its
+                # installed distribution name (e.g. ``PIL`` vs
+                # ``Pillow``). Resolve the distribution name(s) for the
+                # import name and try those.
+                distributions = importlib.metadata.packages_distributions()
+
+                for dist_name in distributions.get(package_name, ()):
+                    try:
+                        version = importlib.metadata.version(dist_name)
+                        break
+                    except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError:
+                        continue
+
+                if version is None:
+                    raise RuntimeError(
+                        f"{package_name!r} is not installed. Try passing"
+                        " 'package_name' instead."
+                    ) from None
